jcr:content.jcr:title: Poets' Walk, Clevedon
jcr:content.jcr:description: A hillside coastal walk above Marine Lake with views across the Bristol Channel.
jcr:content.shortDescription: A hillside coastal walk above Marine Lake with views across the Bristol Channel.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Poets' Walk follows the hills at the southern end of Clevedon seafront. Woodland, open viewpoints and the area around St Andrew's Church give this outing a different feel from a simple promenade stroll.

Start with a short section from the Marine Lake end and decide how far to continue once you have seen the ground underfoot. Our family idea: pause at a viewpoint and see how many different shapes you can spot along the coast.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families comfortable with steps and uneven walking paths.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Seafront facilities are nearby; take drinks for the hillside section.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed parking around Salthouse Fields and check current charges.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The route has steps, slopes and uneven surfaces. Wear shoes with grip and keep children close near steep edges.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Poets Walk via Salthouse Fields car park, Old Church Road, Clevedon, BS21 7TU
placevisitmap.travelNote: Use signed parking around Salthouse Fields and check current charges. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
